story.cli.title: CLI Usage
story.cli.description: Run swagger-api-hub from your terminal. It reads ./swagger-api-hub.config.ts by default, or a config file you pass in.
story.cli.defaultCommand: Generate with the default config file
story.cli.customCommand: Generate with a custom config file
story.cli.multiPrompt: Multiple services: choose which to generate
story.cli.singleDirect: Single service: generate directly without prompting
story.config.title: Config Examples
story.config.description: The configuration file exports a ServiceConfig object or an array of them. A single object generates directly; an array triggers an interactive selection prompt.
story.config.singleDesc: Export one object — code is generated directly, no prompt.
story.config.multiDesc: Export an array — choose which services to generate interactively.
story.config.customHttpDesc: Point httpClientFile to your own request module, e.g. a shared swagger-request.ts.
story.config.advancedDesc: Tune type mappings, route naming and more per service.
story.generated.title: Generated Output
story.generated.description: A preview of the code structure generated from the sample configuration. Files are written under the output directory with modular templates.
story.generated.fileTreeCaption: Generated from the sample config with output: './src/api/iam'
story.generated.generateAgain: Re-generate by editing the config and running the CLI again
story.customHttp.title: Custom Http Client
story.customHttp.description: Point httpClientFile to your own request module to override the axios defaults (baseURL, timeout, headers) of every generated API call.
story.customHttp.sectionConfigDesc: Set httpClientFile to your custom request module. The generated api.ts imports HttpClient from this path instead of the default ./http-client.ts.
story.customHttp.sectionClientDesc: swagger-request.ts extends the generated HttpClient and overrides the axios defaults: a shared axios instance with baseURL/timeout/headers, plus path rewriting in the request override.
story.customHttp.sectionUsageDesc: The generated api.ts imports ContentType, HttpClient, RequestParams and the ApiConfig type from your custom module — no manual changes needed in the generated files.
story.api.title: API Usage
story.api.description: Use swagger-api-hub as a Node.js module inside your build pipeline.
story.api.generateDesc: Generates code for a single service directly.
story.api.promptToGenerateDesc: Shows an interactive prompt when multiple services are passed.
story.api.inlineSpec: You can also pass spec directly instead of url/input:
story.meta.cliUsage: Interactive terminal demo of the swagger-api-hub CLI: default config, custom config path, help and version.
story.meta.configExamples: Typical ServiceConfig examples: single service, multiple services, custom http client and advanced options.
story.meta.generatedOutput: Preview of the generated code structure: modular files (api.ts, data-contracts.ts, http-client.ts, route-types.ts) under the output directory.
story.meta.apiUsage: Using swagger-api-hub as a Node.js module: generate() and promptToGenerate().
